rules: The Konoha world-registry institution scheduler is the only temporal authority for phase reviews; this file does not create a second clock.
A cycle may open only when the scheduled Academy review occurs in a configured start month.
Each later scheduled Academy review advances at most one phase.
Opening or advancing a cycle never invents an exact candidate, exam result, injury, promotion, or future-canon outcome.
Exact promotion still requires persisted promotion eligibility and may advance only one rank.
Every exact rank change synchronizes conserved aggregate village rank counts.
